card.name: Words just before "pacemaker"
card.fires_on: Small words like a, without, no or permanent right before the word pacemaker in heart-block and sick sinus warnings. It fires on the word just ahead of the expected "pacemaker".

modes.label: Article before pacemaker
modes.description: The word a or no sits just before pacemaker in an exception clause such as "unless a pacemaker is in place".
modes.example: Severe bradycardia (unless<< a>> permanent pacemaker is in place)

modes.label: Without or permanent before pacemaker
modes.description: Words like without or permanent come right before pacemaker in conduction-disorder warnings.
modes.example: sick sinus syndrome<< without>> pacemaker), severe cardiac disease

card.writes: It pushes the model to write pac, as in pacemaker or pacing, next.
card.plain: It flags the spot where the text is about to say pacemaker, in heart block warnings.
